title: FIFA 2026 World Cup Winner Prediction
text:
My pick: France!
MGTA 495 — Marketing Analytics
The team is a tournament-experienced squad that made it to the semi-finals during the last FIFA World Cup. They have elite players like Kylian Mbappé, Ousmane Dembélé, and Mike Maignan.

title: FIFA 2026 World Cup Winner Prediction
text:
Why France?

Elite depth: High-level talent across every area of the field, not just a few star players
Big-game experience: Consistently deep tournament runs — this squad knows how to handle knockout pressure
Strong chemistry: Many players are used to performing together in demanding, high-stakes matches
Tactical flexibility: France can win through counterattacks, physicality, or controlling key moments
Match-winners: Players who can change a game instantly with one run, pass, or finish

title: FIFA 2026 World Cup Winner Prediction
text:
Caveats


Injuries — Even one key injury can completely change a team’s chances.




Tournament draw — A difficult bracket path can make even the best team vulnerable.




Knockout variance — One bad performance, one mistake, or one unlucky moment can end a run.


These are the biggest reasons predictions should be treated as probabilities, not guarantees.

title: From Startup Chaos to Smart Deal Flow
text:
The Problem

Marketing analytics applied to venture capital — turning messy deal flow into smarter, prioritized investment decisions.
VCs review thousands of startups, but partner time and attention are limited.
20,000+
startups in the pipeline
Imagine Shark Tank, but with 20,000 startups in a spreadsheet.

  VCs review thousands of pitches every year
  Partner time is the scarcest resource
  Most deals never get a real look
  Great companies get lost in the noise

title: From Startup Chaos to Smart Deal Flow
text:
Before AI

The traditional process is manual, inconsistent, and hard to scale.

  CRM Data→
  Spreadsheets→
  Manual Research→
  PitchBook / Harmonic→
  Gut Feeling→
  Partner Review


  Slow
  Inconsistent
  Hard to Scale
  Data Silos

Every analyst does it differently. High-potential startups slip through when there isn't enough time to research them all.

title: From Startup Chaos to Smart Deal Flow
text:
AI-Assisted Deal Flow

AI gives deal flow a brain — unified data, faster insight, and prioritized review.

  CRM + Harmonic + PitchBook→
  AI Summaries→
  Investment Signals→
  Relevance Scoring→
  Prioritized Deal Flow


  External data unified into one view
  AI distills company narratives in seconds
  Signals surface thesis-fit opportunities automatically
  Partners review the best deals first — not just the loudest

AI doesn't replace judgment — it front-loads intelligence so investors spend time where it matters.

title: From Startup Chaos to Smart Deal Flow
text:
Impact

The goal is not to replace investors — it's to help them focus.

  Less Manual ScreeningAutomate the first pass across thousands of companies
  Faster ReviewAI summaries cut research time from hours to minutes
  Consistent ScoringEvery deal evaluated with the same framework
  Better Data UseHarmonic, PitchBook, and CRM signals unified
  Easier PrioritizationRanked deal flow replaces gut-only triage
  Hidden Gems FoundStrong startups surface before competitors notice

This project applies marketing analytics thinking to venture capital: using AI, segmentation, and relevance scoring to turn messy deal flow into smarter investment decisions.
